subject: Differential pricing and channel commission flow for marketplace private offer
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Duarte <alex@clearpulse.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Differential pricing and channel commission flow for marketplace private offer

Alex — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Following up with a concrete ask so we can get this private offer into the marketplace catalogue and map commission flows for your reseller (Priya's team).

High level: ClearPulse wants a private offer that discounts our hosted rates for their end customers while keeping the listed marketplace SKU for billing visibility. They also want the reseller (ResellerCo) to receive an explicit commission split that triggers at invoice settlement rather than being baked into the list price.

Questions we need to resolve before procurement can build the PO:
- Do you need the list price to remain at our public SKU (yes/no)? If yes, we surface a line-item discount on the PO and pass a commission to the reseller separately.
- Is the reseller commission a flat percentage of billings or tiered by usage bands?
- Are there any minimum commitment months that should carry different commission treatment (e.g., higher commission for first 12 months)?

Attached is a starter worksheet with two options: (A) List-price remains, discount on PO, reseller commission paid as separate pipeline credit; (B) List-price is lowered and reseller receives pass-through margin (harder for invoice routing). Please review the attached "CP-PrivateOffer-20270901.xlsx" and mark preferred path.

If you can confirm answers by end of day tomorrow we can spin up the PO and map the channel waterfall with Finance/RevOps.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: CP-PrivateOffer-20270901.xlsx (excel), redwood-pricing-worksheet.csv (csv)

From: Alex Duarte <alex@clearpulse.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@resellerco.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Differential pricing and channel commission flow for marketplace private offer

Camila — thanks for pulling this together. Quick clarifications inline: 

> Do you need the list price to remain at our public SKU (yes/no)?
We prefer the list price to remain (visibility in marketplace), but we also need ClearPulse commercial team to see a net price after discount in their billing portal. So option A sounds better.

> Is the reseller commission flat or tiered?
Priya (copied) prefers a simple waterfall: 18% for first $250k ARR, 12% beyond that. Can Redwood handle a two-tier commission binding to the PO settlement?

> Minimum commitment months?
ClearPulse wants a 24-month commitment but is open to higher reseller commission for the first 12 months to accelerate adoption.

One more ask: can you confirm if we can surface a separate line in the invoice metadata that flags the reseller commission for downstream reconciliation? We need that for our internal revenue share tracking.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Differential pricing and channel commission flow for marketplace private offer

Alex / Camila — looping in a single proposal from RevOps view so we can lock the PO fast. We can support the waterfall and invoice metadata you requested, with the following operational approach: 

1) Private Offer mechanics: we keep the public SKU list price unchanged. The private offer is implemented as a line-item discount on the ClearPulse PO (option A). This preserves marketplace listing and audit trail.

2) Reseller commission handling: Redwood will emit an invoice-level metadata tag (reseller_id + commission_pct) and a settlement file that Finance can use to calculate payable commissions. For the two-tier commission, RevOps will run the watermark when monthly invoice totals hit threshold $250k.

3) Timing & payouts: Commission is paid monthly post-invoice once the settlement file has been reconciled. For first 12 months, we can set the commission to 18% for amounts up to $250k, then 12% thereafter. After month 12, commission steps to baseline 10% unless otherwise renegotiated.

4) Accounting note: If ClearPulse requires commissions to show as a separate credit on the customer's invoice, that is possible but will require a conduit invoice to ResellerCo (extra accounting touch). We recommend Redwood handle as settlement credits to minimize invoice complexity for end customers.

Next steps I propose:
- Alex / Priya confirm acceptance of the 18%/$250k band for first 12 months and the 10% baseline after 12 months.
- Camila to confirm whether ClearPulse insists on invoice-line visibility for reseller credit.
- If yes, we'll loop Legal/Tax for conduit invoice flow and get a quick technical spec to RevOps to implement metadata tags.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/clearpulse/CLEAR-PO-2027-09 (updated with proposed waterfall).
Doc: https://docsend.com/d/clearpulse-private-offer-v1

Ben Carter
Director, RevOps 
Redwood Inference

Ben / Camila — this looks good and aligns with our procurement constraints. Priya — can you confirm on ResellerCo side that the two-tier (18% up to $250k, 12% thereafter for first 12 months, then baseline 10%) is acceptable? If yes, we'll sign off and I will ask Legal to approve the PO language referencing the settlement file for commission payout.

Priya, if you need the invoice-line credit visible to your customers we can discuss, but we prefer Redwood handling settlement credits as Ben mentioned (less customer confusion).

Thanks all — once Priya confirms we'll run the PO through procurement and provide the private-offer ID for marketplace submission.

— Alex
Head of Procurement, ClearPulse
